property_summary: For any owner-initiated call to withdrawFees(asset, recipient), the contract must observe its own stored unclaimedFees[asset] value as zero for the entire duration of the external ERC20 transfer it makes, because it must zero that mapping before making the external call; a re-entrant asset can check C.unclaimedFees(asset) during the callback and will see a nonzero value in the mutant, while the reference always exposes zero.
change_summary: Move the external ERC20 transfer call before the unclaimedFees[asset] state reset, so a re-entrant callee can observe/act on the fee balance while the external call is in progress.
